name: the trigger is never installed
from:
create trigger notify_message_recipients
  after insert on public.messages
to:
create trigger notify_message_recipients
  after insert on public.conversations

name: the sender is notified of their own message
everybody is notified, not just the participants
a burst of messages becomes one entry each
from:
on conflict (user_id, entity_type, entity_id)
    where read_at is null and entity_type is not null
  do update set
to:
on conflict do nothing;
  update public.notifications set

name: the de-duplication index is dropped
from: create unique index if not exists notifications_unread_entity_uniq
to: create index if not exists notifications_unread_entity_uniq

name: the index stops being partial, so history blocks the next one
from: where read_at is null and entity_type is not null;

name: the entry stops moving to the top
the preview stops updating to the newest message
an attachment-only message previews as a blank line
it stops saying what it is about
it is titled something other than the sender
reading the conversation no longer clears the bell
from:
update public.notifications
  set read_at = now()
  where user_id = auth.uid()
    and entity_type = 'conversation'
to:
update public.notifications
  set read_at = now()
  where false
    and entity_type = 'conversation'

name: reading one conversation clears every other one too
from:
and entity_id = target_conversation_id
    and read_at is null

name: reading the conversation stops moving the watermark
anybody can mark anybody's notification read
anybody can delete anybody's notification
to:
delete from public.notifications
  where id = target_notification;

name: the tray helpers are left open to a signed-out visitor
from: revoke all on function public.mark_notification_read(uuid) from public, anon;
to: revoke all on function public.mark_notification_read(uuid) from public;
